Word-by-word collation of MT 135:17 against MT 115:6 gives byte-equality at positions 0-2 (אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א), the substitution at position 3 (יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ against יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ), accent-only difference at position 4 and divergence from position 5 on — so 'inside the four-word clause the two verses set in the same slot, of which they share the first three words at byte tier' is precisely what the bytes give, and the killed phrasing ('inside the four words the two verses hold in common', which was true on no reading) is gone. Tiling 135:13-14 / 15-18 / 19-21 is exact and neither M8-Ps-445 nor M8-Ps-447 is contradicted — 445's prefix-conjugation reading of MT 135:14 is the same one this row's rejected alternative uses. No unswept universal, no placeholder, no register bleed, no tier-4 metadata doing driver work; span, unit_type and confidence unchanged and coherent.
